global_constraints.morphology_lock: Strictly adhere to ID: CM_CRANEFLY_CHAR_01. Maintain slender, non-waisted, pale-amber abdomen in all poses.
global_constraints.leg_integrity: Legs must remain thread-like and disproportionately long (stilt-walker style) regardless of action.
global_constraints.negative_prompt_logic: No wasp-like banding, no thorax thickening, no predatory or 'armored' insect traits.

top_left.description: An adult crane fly crawling from its pupal case; highlight the 'pale-amber' and 'cream' segmented body as it unfurls; legs are long, pale, and delicate.
top_left.educational_note: Shows the transition from water/damp soil to air.

top_right.description: Perched on a shrubby angiosperm; maintain the cylindrical, 'mosquito-like' humped thorax; avoid any wasp-like abdominal tapering while sipping.
top_right.educational_note: Highlights their role as early pollinators.

bottom_left.description: Hanging vertically from a Conifer needle; legs are loosely tucked but remain visibly 'thread-like' and stilt-long; body remains light-toned.
bottom_left.educational_note: Shows how they hide from predators and weather.

bottom_right.description: Two flies in a bobbing flight; emphasize the 'bumbling' clumsy movement; bodies must stay pale-amber against the dark maroon rocks.
bottom_right.educational_note: Visualizes the rhythmic flight behavior common to the species.
